Want to play a match against a specific player? Simply run `/challenge send`!
Tired of submitting bases again and again? Run `/preset base add` to automatically set them by default!
Run `/player hitrates` to get a detailed idea of how good your opponent is.
Tired of manually selecting districts and confirming matches? Run `/preset district add` to automate the process!
Unable to challenge a player due to high Elo difference? Simply ask the Elo admins for a override code.
Are you finding the Elo bases hard? Besides hosting matches, our 1v1 helpers are also here to teach you meta strategies!
Do not forget to enter for giveaways in <#1214445497109057556>, there are always 2 gold pass giveaways each season!
Run `/match base remove` if you would like to remove a base you accidentally submitted.
Wondering who the best/||worst|| players here are? Check out `/leaderboard` command!
Use `/base submit` to submit your bases for review and inclusion in the Helper bank. You'll be notified once accepted!
Once you have reached 1200 Elo, you can claim certified attacker role to increase your rizz in the server!
If there is a bug with the Elo bot or you got suggestions for it, feel free to DM [@James](<https://discordapp.com/users/653894110884921366>).
Run `/preset base remove` and `/preset district remove` to remove your presets!
A war style Elo match duration is about 15 minutes, and you can attack at any time!
You can start your match at any time, simply ping @1v1 helpers in your match thread when ready!
Did you know that you can check leaderboards in the past Elo seasons? Check out `/season leaderboard` command!
For base builder wondering who build the best bases, check out `/base leaderboard` and `/season base leaderboard`
Wondering who is the better of the two? Check out `/player h2h` command!
Clicking on the "Submit Bases" button under the match confirmation embed to prevent your opponent from attacking without waiting for you to submit bases.
Use `/private base add` to store your own bases permenantly, and `/private base list` to view them or use them as presets.
Use `/match autoqueue` to automatically queue after match end.
